scope: First MiniMax-H3 EPIC Ego window generation using v4 controls
summary: The first pour generation produced plausible first-person mechanical hands and bottle interaction but faithfully copied the control's black counter rectangle, so the campaign was stopped during shake step 3/20.
evidence: The completed pour midframe contains a dark rectangular patch adjacent to the bottle matching the v4 control matte.
The remote metadata records the selected GPU and stopped/failed campaign state; no output from this directory is routed to the demo.
lessons: Early generated-frame review is an effective stop gate because conditioning artifacts can propagate even when the model produces strong robot geometry.
limitations: The run did not complete all actions and its pour output is visually invalid.
next_actions: Regenerate from v5 controls in a new immutable experiment directory.
